note: Eldorado NF campground on the granite north shore of Loon Lake in the Crystal Basin, 31 miles up Ice House Road from US-50, in two loops of single and double family sites; the front row sits on an open granite slope above the water. The boat ramp and dump station are at Loon Lake Campground nearby. Bears frequent the area: food and scented items go in the lockers. --Claude
summary: Northshore (Loon Lake, Eldorado NF): lakefront KEPT - front-row sites 10, 17 (and 12, 13, 15, 19 at ~60 m) sit on an open granite apron 40-60 m from the full-pool edge (lidar); fees $36 single/$72 double + $5 vehicle; rec.gov some_sites (7 FCFS sites), reservations 06-18..09-06; season 05-26..09-20 (FS: late June-September); 25 sites, RVs to 50 ft; vault toilets, potable water; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT KEEP lakefront: Esri imagery shows the front-row pads on an open, bare granite/sand apron sloping gently to Loon Lake. 3DEP lidar puts the lake surface at 1953.27 m (essentially full pool, ~6,408 ft), pads at 1959-1963 m, and the water's edge 40 m from site 10 (38.99867,-120.31996; RV to 25 ft, reservable), 40 m from 11 (38.99874,-120.31926; RV to 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft rig), 50 m from 9 (38.99869,-120.32043; RV to 20 ft, first-come) and 17 (38.99938,-120.31763; RV to 35 ft, reservable), 60 m from 12 (38.99895,-120.31871), 13 (38.99901,-120.31836), 15 (38.99923,-120.31791) and 19 (38.99955,-120.31755). The rise is ~6-9 m over 40-60 m of open rock (a gentle slope, no bank). All are nightly sites. Proposed evidence: 'Esri imagery + 3DEP lidar (2026-11-26): front-row sites 10 and 17 (RV to 25/35 ft, nightly) sit 40-50 m over an open granite apron from Loon Lake at full pool (lidar water 1953.27 m); 12, 13, 15, 19 at ~60 m.'
